div.head: Hn Lond Prol.
div.ab: Henricus, Dei gratia rex Angliae, archiepiscopo Cantuar[iensi] et episcopis et abbatibus et comitibus et baronibus et iusticiis et vicecomitibus et omnibus fidelibus suis, Francis et Anglicis, tocius Angliae—salutem.

Henry, by the grace of God King of England, to the Archbishop of Canterbury and the bishops, abbots, earls, barons, justiciars, sheriffs and all his loyal subjects, both French and English, throughout the whole of England—greeting.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 288–289 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
